authors_reviews.title: Awesome dog bath set!
authors_reviews.text: I recently tried the Pet Grooming 3-Pack Dog Bathing Set — which includes the super-absorbent microfiber towel, a soft & gentle brush glove, and a hand-held bath brush; and it has genuinely made bath time easier and more enjoyable for both me and my dog. The microfiber towel is incredibly absorbent. Right after a bath, it soaks up water far better than regular towels I’ve used before, which cuts down on drying time and keeps my floors cleaner. The fabric feels soft against my dog’s skin and doesn’t tug on his fur, which he definitely appreciates. The brush glove is a highlight. It’s comfortable to wear, fits well on my hand, and the gentle silicone bristles make grooming feel more like petting than brushing. My dog loves it; he stays calm and relaxed instead of trying to squirm away. It’s especially great for removing loose hair and giving him a smooth, shiny coat. The hand-held bath brush works really well during bath time. The grip is comfortable, and the bristles help distribute shampoo evenly while loosening dirt and debris. It helps get deep down into his coat without irritating his skin. The brush rinses clean easily, which makes cleanup a breeze. Overall, this set balances comfort, practicality, and quality. It’s clearly designed with both pets and pet owners in mind, and it’s made grooming routines simpler and more pleasant. I’d definitely recommend this 3-pack to anyone looking for a thoughtful, effective grooming solution for their dog.

authors_reviews.title: Best Bath Time Upgrade! My Pets Actually Enjoy Grooming Now
authors_reviews.text: I purchased the Paw Mountain PW Pet Grooming Tools hoping to make bath time a little easier, and this set exceeded every expectation. I have both a medium-sized dog and a long-haired cat, and finding products that work well for both can be a challenge. This 3-pack changed that completely.From the first use, I could feel the difference. The tools are designed with soft, flexible bristles that glide smoothly over the skin — no pulling, scratching, or irritation. My dog, who normally tries to escape the tub, actually settled in and seemed to enjoy the massaging feel. The cat, who usually protests grooming, tolerated it way longer than usual, and that alone felt like a miracle.What impressed me most is how much loose hair these tools collect while bathing. Instead of shedding happening all over the house afterward, it rinses right away, leaving their coats clean, shiny, and noticeably softer. The variety in the three tools makes it super convenient — one is great for gentle shampooing, one for detangling and lifting dirt, and the last one works really well to remove excess fur and give a final smooth finish.The quality feels solid, the grips are comfortable even with wet hands, and cleanup is fast — just rinse and they’re ready for the next bath.If you’re someone who wants a stress-free grooming routine, or if your pets aren’t big fans of being brushed, this set is a must-have. It turns bath time into bonding time, reduces shedding, and leaves my pets looking and smelling fresh. I wish I found it sooner!

authors_reviews.title: Flexible tools to follow body contours.
authors_reviews.text: The Paw Mountain grooming set is perfect for short hair dogs. The microfiber towel is huge! It would dry a large dog well. My Collie can soak 2 large bath towels, but this one towel worked well. It is also a lot lighter than standard cotton towels. The large grooming mitt was a little big for my hand, and the nubs were a bit short for a long hair dogs, but I can see how the mitt would work well on a short hair dogs or even a horse. I am going to try it on my horses when warm weather comes around again. The back of the mitt is made of quick drying mesh with a Velcro tab. The small curry type grooming tool did work well on my Collie, though, massaging the shampoo and conditioner through his coat well. It adjusted easily to the size of my hands. I appreciate that the mitts are flexible enough to curve around doggie body parts. The mitts are soft and gentle on the dog too. When I was finished with the dog’s bath, the tools rinsed clean of hair easily and I just threw the towel in the washer. This three pack made bath time easy!

authors_reviews.title: Good for Grooming, Poor for Drying
authors_reviews.text: This three-piece set includes a grooming mitt, a handheld scrub tool, and a microfiber towel. While the grooming mitt worked well on my short-haired dog—trapping loose fur as I petted her and making cleanup easy—the rest of the kit was a bit hit-or-miss. The mitt likely wouldn't be effective for long-haired or double-coated breeds.The handheld scrub tool is excellent for lifting dander and dirt, but the silicone prongs are quite firm; I had to go slowly to ensure it wasn't irritating my dog’s skin. It would probably be better suited for a dog with a thicker coat. The biggest disappointment was the microfiber towel, which is so thin it’s nearly translucent. It lacked the absorbency needed to dry my dog, forcing me to switch to a standard towel. Given the poor quality of the towel and the specific coat requirements for the other tools, I don’t believe this kit offers good value for the price.

authors_reviews.title: Makes baths easier
authors_reviews.text: This grooming set has all the tools you need to give your dog is a great bath. The microfiber towel is huge and does a great job of absorbing water. My dog was soaking wet, and after drying her with this she was only a little bit damp. The bath brush has flexible bristles so it can easily get deep into your dog’s fur and get them really clean, but the side that touches your hand is smooth and when it gets soapy it’s hard to keep on your hand, even with the strap. The mitt stays on my hand and I imagine would make it much easier to deshed, however my dog doesn’t really shed so I couldn’t test its effectiveness very well.

authors_reviews.title: Grooming set that works
authors_reviews.text: I’m really liking this grooming set. Even though it’s Winter and my dogs aren’t shedding as much right now, the grooming brush still pulls up a surprising amount of loose hair and helps keep shedding under control in the house.I started by washing my dogs’ blankets and cleaning their bedding, then brushed them outside. After a few days, I expected to see a lot more hair on their bedding, but there was very little. With regular brushing, dog hair in our home should stay minimal.The towel is a great size and easily dries both of my small dogs. It’s soft and feels like microfiber. Everything in the set works well. I was initially unsure if the scrubber and brush would fit my large hands, but they do, and they’re comfortable to use.Overall, this is a solid grooming set. It’s easy to use, well made, and feels durable, with a nice silicone-like quality.
